empty: Create a sample order to begin.
roleplay: The signed-in order owner performs the sample approval roles.
prerequisite: Complete the prior step to produce evidence.
indexGap: Seals in stock / report missing from index
pendingRecord: No receipt for this order yet
rolePending: Results appear when this node runs.
noDesk: Node unavailable in this round. Select a node for this order.
notRunSkip: This order followed the alternate path. This node has no execution receipt.
pipelinePending: The native pipeline has not started.
unavailableHistory: This workbench shows current order data. Inspect historical rounds in the native pipeline.
purpose_intake: Which ingress rating applies to the assembly and which to the terminal box?
purpose_bom: Compare the reference configuration to the order, then extend the per-unit change to the order quantity.
purpose_lock: Confirm the changes, order scope and test requirement before releasing the BOM to purchasing.
purpose_supply: Separate on-hand and in-transit supply before committing to earlier delivery.
purpose_materialRoute: Compare required and available quantities to decide whether purchasing must confirm lead time.
purpose_expediteCheck: Check normal and expedited arrival dates and hand the surcharge to planning.
purpose_schedule: Which test slot and existing work order would earlier delivery affect?
purpose_commit: Choose a full, split or original delivery plan and accept the cost and impact.
purpose_build: Link the frozen BOM, installed seal lot and first motor serial to the work order.
purpose_test: Match the inspected serial, test report and first-pass result before release.
purpose_release: Verify the inspection report, lot and quantity before signing release.
purpose_ship: Reconcile the approved schedule with dispatch and proof of delivery.
purpose_trace: Identify the returned motor and preserve the complaint and teardown as distinct evidence.
purpose_traceFork: Dispatch the MES and QMS lookups for the same motor.
purpose_asBuilt: Trace the reported serial back to its work order, installed seal lot and BOM.
purpose_benchReport: Record the index lookup and the serial linked to the returned report.
purpose_traceJoin: Both lookups must return before verification. An index miss is a lookup receipt.
purpose_traceRoute: Compare the motor serial, assembly and report index to decide whether to retrieve the archive.
purpose_recoverReport: Retrieve the archived report by work order and verify the serial on the original.
purpose_cause: Separate the symptom, verified cause, corrective action and effectiveness window.
purpose_replay: Compare results against labeled clauses, including component-only and ambiguous cases.
purpose_publish: Review the evaluation and approved measure before publishing the rule for the next order.
purpose_complete: Inspect the publication receipt and start a successor with the approved knowledge.
purpose_returned: Inspect the gate, time and reason that stopped this order.
